answer: Because you financed through Bayline Credit Union, Bayline holds your title until the loan is paid off, not Northwind. To sell with a loan, you'll typically need a payoff letter from Bayline showing your account number, the payoff amount (ask for a 15-day amount), the good-through date, and where to send payment. You can also sign form NW-LPA-1 and we'll request it for you (allow 2 business days), and you don't need a letter at all if your lender is in our e-payoff network. The help center doesn't say whether Bayline is in that network, so please contact a store to check.
